parrafo_2.es: Las resenas en Google repiten lo mismo: perros que llegan nerviosos y salen felices, con el pelaje impecable y el dueno tranquilo.

items.quote: I had taken my golden retriever for Jennifer to groom a couple times a year and was very happy with everything. I took my daughter's new goldendoodle puppy Charli there today and am so happy with the job she did on such a very crazy active puppy.

Brought my dog in here and was definitely scared and hesitant because the last groomer we went to had to shave all his fur down and he did not look himself. But taking him here from the phone call to dropping him off to receiving him after was wonderful.

Ashley has groomed my dog Buddy every 3 weeks for several years. He always comes home smelling so clean and his coat sparkles! He is an American Staffordshire mix, a breed many groomers are afraid of. Ashley just loves on Buddy.
